focus: Decompose public XRP exchange-wallet balances into customer/custody, cold storage and cross-chain wrapped-token backing; verify Coinbase cbXRP reserve/supply from Coinbase's official dashboard; distinguish Binance XRP-BF2 mechanism from secondary current reserve quantity; identify the unresolved crosswalk between compromised Binance wallets and wrapped-token backing wallets.

wrapped_reserve_decomposition.status: XRP Insights public-label aggregation; Coinbase cbXRP amount corroborated by official dashboard; Binance current XRP-BF2 amount remains secondary.

derived_adjustment.interpretation: A correction to broad exchange-labeled wallet totals, not a tradable-float estimate. The remainder still includes customer custody, cold storage, operational funds and unclassified wallets.

venue_concentrations.qualifications: Shares are illustrative and depend on address-label overlap; they do not measure proprietary or executable inventory.

same_wallet_changes.methodology: XRP Insights compares the same tracked wallets at both endpoints; label coverage changes can create apparent step-changes if not controlled.

coinbase_cbxrp.evidence: Coinbase official cbXRP proof-of-reserves dashboard; official Help documentation confirms 1:1 backing.
coinbase_cbxrp.cache_limitation: Search-indexed Coinbase official page returned Oct29 09:14 values; direct page open returned an older Oct6 cached figure of 138,280,081.19 XRP reserve and 138,277,833.66 cbXRP supply. Multiple regional Coinbase search results repeated the Oct29 values; preserve cache discrepancy and do not silently overwrite.

binance_xrp_bf2.mechanism: Binance's 2019 official announcement says XRP-BF2 on Binance Chain/BNB Chain is backed 1:1 by native XRP in a publicly disclosed address.
binance_xrp_bf2.compromised_wallet_crosswalk: UNKNOWN; public Bitquery article identifies receiver but does not list all five source-wallet addresses.

incident_crosswalk.warning: This ratio is not evidence the XRP-BF2 reserve was compromised. The five source addresses and the reserve address have not been crosswalked.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Public exchange-labeled XRP balances materially overstate immediately tradable float because they include cold custody and known wrapped-token backing reserves.
support: XRP Insights identifies 488.4M XRP as wrapped reserves/insurance/charity within the 22.58B tracked total
Coinbase official cbXRP PoR reports 151.405M XRP reserve backing 151.403M cbXRP
counter: Other tracked balances include customer deposits that may be available for trading; no full per-wallet hot/cold/liability classification
The 488.4M reserve estimate is not a complete classification of all wallets

competing_hypotheses.claim: If one of the five compromised Binance XRPL source wallets was the XRP-BF2 backing address, wrapped XRP collateral could have been impaired.
support: XRP-BF2 is designed as 1:1 native XRP-backed per Binance's historical announcement
XRP Insights estimates 325.8M XRP in Binance XRP-BF2 reserve/funds
233.46M XRP was drained from five Binance XRPL wallets
counter: Bitquery reports the attacker receiver balance but does not identify all five source addresses
No cbXRP/XRP-BF2 depeg or reserve shortfall measured

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's cbXRP creates a measurable Base-native XRP exposure channel while keeping backing XRP in Coinbase custody.
support: Coinbase official PoR shows 151.405M XRP reserve and 151.403M cbXRP supply on Base
counter: No causal relationship between cbXRP growth and native XRP spot demand or price impact measured
Dashboard cache returned conflicting older data in direct page open
